result.description: Compact NVMe solid-state storage built for everyday desktops and portable workstations. The Lunaris Drift uses a PCIe 4.0 x4 interface, delivers 2TB of internal flash capacity, and is tuned for quiet, low-power operation in thin systems and upgrade kits.
result.title: Lunaris Drift 2TB PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSD
